statements.quote: The lease represents approximately $19 billion of contracted revenue over the initial term and up to approximately $33 billion if Anthropic exercises both five-year extension options.
statements.notes: Contracted AI data-center lease revenue from Anthropic, summed over the 20-year initial term ($19B) or up to 30 years with both extensions ($33B). This is a multi-year contract total, not revenue for any single fiscal year, so fiscal_year is null and the code default (year after filing) should not be read as the year the amount is earned. Low and high are two contract-length scenarios, not a guidance range.
